khm.text: Arni Brokenbrow is the Tuskeri's new leader, and he charges the Skelle line at the front, leaping over their spears and shields to kill a raider as the Skelle break and flee.

Hormgart tells how Arni, once called Goatleaper, won his new name by proposing a headbutting contest to a warren of trolls and breaking a troll's tusk with his skull, leaving bone embedded in his forehead.
He later lassoes a hellkite's horn and kills it, then refuses to grovel in an honor duel with Tover Giants-Blood and breaks out of a crushing bear hug with a headbutt to win.

At the Beskir Stronghold Arni joins the leaders who ride giant ravens with Kaya toward Halvar, and when Varragoth knocks him into the air, Kaya catches him and phases them through the river, after which Arni stays behind to hold the draugr horde.
